description: US federal tax deadlines — Every IRS federal due date for a calendar year, already rolled forward for weekends and Washington DC holidays (incl. DC Emancipation Day): 1040/4868/1040-ES, 1065/1120-S, 1120 with fiscal years and corporate estimates, 1041, 990, payroll 941/940/W-2/1099, FBAR, Form 5500. Params: year (default this year), entity=individual|partnership|s-corp|c-corp|trust|exempt|employer|all, fye=fiscal year-end month 1-12, from=YYYY-MM-DD, limit. Returns next deadline with daysLeft. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
